name: SAML Auth Provider
description: SAML 2.0 authentication provider for enterprise SSO. Compatible with Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin, Shibboleth, and ADFS via the Web Browser SSO Profile.
author: Example Author

idpEntityId.description: The Identity Provider's entity ID. Found in the IdP's SAML metadata XML under <EntityDescriptor entityID="...">.

idpSsoUrl.description: The IdP's Single Sign-On URL for the HTTP-POST binding. Found in the IdP's SAML metadata under <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="...">.

idpCertificate.description: The IdP's X.509 signing certificate in PEM format. Used to verify the signature on SAML responses. Found in the IdP's SAML metadata under <KeyDescriptor use="signing">.

spEntityId.description: Your application's Service Provider entity ID. This value is included in SAML AuthnRequests and must match the AudienceRestriction in SAML responses.

emailAttributeName.description: The SAML attribute name that contains the user's email address. Common values: 'email', 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress', 'urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3'.

groupAttributeName.description: The SAML attribute name that contains the user's group memberships. Used for role mapping. Common values: 'groups', 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/claims/Group', 'memberOf'.

roleMapping.description: Map of IdP group name to OnePlatform role name. Groups not listed here are ignored. Example: { "Engineering": "developer", "IT-Admins": "platform-admin" }.

clockSkewToleranceSeconds.description: Maximum allowed clock difference between the IdP and OnePlatform servers (in seconds). Increase if you see time-related assertion validation failures.

requiredCredentials.name: idpCertificate
requiredCredentials.description: The IdP's X.509 signing certificate in PEM format. Optional — can also be provided in the config. Use this credential slot when the certificate needs to be rotated without changing the plugin configuration.
